description: Image Description: The image depicts a piece of street art on a wooden panel. The primary subject of the artwork is a large, stylized toaster drawn in a simple, cartoon-like manner. The toaster is white with black outlines and features two slots on the top. Below the toaster, there is an abstract, colorful shape resembling an orange slice with a mix of orange and white colors.
